project.name: gradle-convention-plugin
project.description: A Gradle convention plugin and build-logic repository for Frisboo Bank that centralizes Kotlin/JVM toolchain, quality (spotless, detekt, ktlint), Spring Boot, gRPC, OpenAPI, Kafka, Redis, persistence, and testing conventions into a reusable plugin.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the settings file to understand the project name, included builds and version catalog wiring.

tour.title: CI Pipeline
tour.description: The GitHub Actions workflow triggers the Gradle build and publish on every push and pull request.

tour.title: Version Catalog
tour.description: The version catalog pins every plugin, library and bundle version used across the build.

tour.title: Build Logic Included Build
tour.description: The included build-logic provides reusable Kotlin and quality Gradle conventions plus a catalog constants generator.

tour.title: Convention Plugin Entry Point
tour.description: CoreBankingConventionPlugin is the main Gradle plugin that conditionally applies all subsystem managers.

tour.title: Plugin Configuration Model
tour.description: PluginExtension exposes toggles and nested subsystem extensions; ConfigurationConstants and CatalogVersionConstants provide keys and aliases.

tour.title: Subsystem Managers
tour.description: Each manager configures a subsystem (Kotlin, Spring Boot, quality, gRPC, messaging, persistence, caching, testing) using its extension and the version catalog.

tour.title: Language Toolchain Managers
tour.description: JavaLanguage and KotlinLanguage configure toolchains, compiler options and dependencies.

tour.title: Quality Sub-Extensions & Helpers
tour.description: Quality extension aggregates cpd, detekt, dokka, jacoco, kover, owasp, pitest, pmd, spotbugs and spotless; helpers configure each tool.

tour.title: Shared Utilities
tour.description: DependencyHandler, BomExtensionSpec and File provide reusable helpers used by managers and extensions.

tour.title: Integration Tests
tour.description: Gradle TestKit-based integration tests verify the plugin applies and configures quality correctly.

tour.title: Root Build & Configuration
tour.description: The root build script and editor/license configuration tie everything together.
